objective: Add a private exact-scope lifetime BP Top 10 to Cluster Home and Organization Home, showing active members only and never disclosing another scope's or former members' BP.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: GitHub main SHA a4badb341c16444fa42c44a5e0906760b85d2a08 uses BuklodClusterHomeCommandCenterImpl for Cluster Home and BuklodScopeHomeDashboard for Organization Home. Production BUKLOD Connect Supabase yhanxndaqbmuzbdqlblu has canonical buklod_user_points_balances lifetime_points and ACTIVE membership records, with 24 active Cluster scopes and 34 active Organizations on 2026-11-10. New additive migration 20261110093333 applied to Supabase; live simulated-member and outsider/anonymous SQL checks for both scope types passed. No RC binary, installed-app test, or OTA production publication is implied.
acceptanceChecks: Both canonical Cluster and Organization Home show a compact Member BP Top 10 card after first-view ad without changing existing functionality.
The exact selected scope's ACTIVE, not-left, active-profile members only can see rankings.
The backend checks viewer membership before returning any data; outsiders and anonymous callers are denied.
Lifetime BP uses canonical balances, with deterministic descending order, 0 BP allowed, and at most 10 rows.
No cross-account persisted cache; stale responses ignored on navigation/auth changes; retry available.
Backend test and focused Node source regression pass; no production OTA or web publish.
chosenApproach: Add one membership-guarded, read-only exact-scope Supabase RPC and one reusable lightweight Home component. Use canonical lifetime_points, never client-side global leaderboard filtering.
selectionRationale: A global leaderboard filtered on the phone could leak unrelated user points and miss scope members outside the global top limit. Server-side authorization and ranking enforce correct scope and Top 10.
alternativeApproaches: Filter existing global leaderboard client-side: rejected because it is not scoped to memberships, may be incomplete and can disclose unrelated people.
Download all members and their ledger rows to the app: rejected because of privacy, load and cross-account cache risks.
Use a membership-guarded SQL RPC returning at most ten rows: chosen.
preserveBehaviors: Existing global BP leaderboard, Circle Rank, Kingdom level, QMP, earnings and redemption ledgers remain unchanged.
Existing scope-specific navigation, earnings card, first-view ad, and configurable Cluster widgets remain available.
No hidden administrator bypass of member-only ranking; no public Home leaderboard changes.
Never push OTA or Expo Web production publish from this workstream.
